Cleanup reference uses incorrect alias - should be 'idp-alias-' + i instead of 'alias'.

adjudication_records.issue_text: server-spi/src/main/java/org/keycloak/models/IdentityProviderStorageProvider.java:253 — getLoginPredicate's new org/BROKER_PUBLIC clause calls idp.getConfig().get(...) with no null-check on getConfig(), risking an NPE if an IdentityProviderModel is ever built with a null config map

adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `idp -> idp.getOrganizationId() == null || Boolean.parseBoolean(idp.getConfig().get(OrganizationModel.BROKER_PUBLIC))` to `LoginFilter.getLoginPredicate()`. This dereferences `idp.getConfig()` without a null-check; while `Objects::nonNull` ensures `idp` isn’t null, the diff does not show any guarantee that `getConfig()` can’t be null. That makes the finding a valid diff-grounded robustness concern, but whether it is an actual bug depends on `IdentityProviderModel`’s contract/implementation, which is not shown in the diff.
